Microsoft Copilot is redefining the future of work by bringing the power of AI directly into your everyday tools. We are looking for a **Product Manager II** to join us on this mission to build a truly AI-first assistant that fits seamlessly into the workflows of our users. This is a high-impact role where you will shape the experience for millions of users using the Copilot app on their desktop devices, working at the intersection of AI, productivity, and mobile innovation.

We’re looking for a customer-focused Product Manager II to join us on this mission.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50- mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.

 **Responsibilities**  

* Use data, customer insights and partnership across PM, engineering, data science, user research and design disciplines to develop and deliver product improvements with hypothesis for growth, discovery and satisfaction in the Copilot app (Windows/Mac).
* Develop deep understanding of the business, our customers, and the competitive landscape through market and customer research.
* Partner across engineering teams, design, marketing, and business execute on the roadmap — focus on rapid iteration, learning and improvement.
* Define clear metrics and projected impact for all investments using a product and customer led growth approach.
* Foster an environment that encourages diversity of thought and an inclusive team culture in a geographically distributed and hybrid work environment.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's Degree AND 2+ years experience in product/service/program management or software development.
  + OR equivalent experience.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 3+ years of Product/Program Management experience on end-user facing products.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, related field or equivalent industry experience.
* Experience and expertise with data to address business needs, apply analytical and inferential techniques to answer questions and produce product recommendations in partnership across disciplines preferred.
* Proven ability to develop product roadmaps to deliver customer and business value across products and services.
* Experience working with data or AI-powered products to deliver greater user value.
* Track record of successful design, delivery, and iteration on complex projects with a diverse set of stakeholders.
* Experience with customer-centric and data-driven insights creation, strategy definition, and experimentation.
* Customer empathy with experience in user-centered design; demonstrated success.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

jobs.title: Brand and Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description** : Tak Tak Toys is a leading homegrown Indian toy brand focused on fun, safe, and family-centric play experiences. The company offers a broad range of toys for all age groups, including baby, toddler, educational, and action toys that support child development, creativity, and motor skills.

Tak Tak Toys also features exclusive licensed products from globally recognized brands such as Marvel, Hello Kitty, and Fisher-Price, combining beloved characters with trusted quality and safety. Designed for both independent play and shared family moments, the brand aims to reduce screen time and encourage meaningful, hands-on play.

**Role Description** : This is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. We are looking for a Brand & Marketing professional who can take ownership of building and strengthening the TakTak Toys brand. The candidate will be responsible for developing the brand presence, managing social media, driving consumer engagement, and executing marketing initiatives across online and offline channels.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience working with an established consumer brand, preferably in Toys, Kids, FMCG, Consumer Products, Lifestyle, or D2C.

**Key Responsibilities**

- Develop and execute brand-building and marketing strategies for TakTak Toys.

- Own the brand's social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and other relevant platforms.

- Plan and manage the monthly content calendar, campaigns, launches and promotional activities.

- Work closely with creative agencies, designers, influencers and other external partners.

- Develop engaging brand content, campaigns, reels, product stories and communication.

- Identify opportunities to increase brand awareness, engagement and consumer reach.

- Support new product launches with appropriate marketing and communication plans.

- Monitor social media and marketing performance and provide regular insights and reports.

- Conduct competitor and market analysis to identify trends and opportunities.

- Maintain consistency in brand identity, tone, messaging and visual communication across channels.

- Collaborate with the sales and e-commerce teams to support business growth through marketing initiatives.

- Explore and execute influencer marketing, collaborations, events and other brand-building activities.

**Candidate Profile**

- 3–6 years of relevant experience in Brand Marketing / Marketing / Digital Marketing.

- Must have hands-on experience working with a consumer brand.

- Strong understanding of brand building and social media marketing.

- Good understanding of Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and digital content trends.

- Strong communication, creative thinking and execution skills.

- Ability to independently plan and execute marketing campaigns.

- Should be comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

- Experience in Toys, Kids, FMCG, D2C, Consumer Durables or Lifestyle brands will be an advantage.

**What We Are Looking For**

We’re looking for a brand owner. Someone who will treat TakTak Toys like their own, knows how to build a brand from the ground up, creates content that families connect with, grows our digital presence, and turns brand visibility into real business growth.

If you’re excited by the idea of shaping how kids and parents across India experience play, we’d love to hear from you.

---------------

Amazon's mission is to be 'Earth's most customer-centric company,' and our award-winning Customer Service (CS) team is an essential part of that mission. Amazon CS is one of the largest customer service organizations in the world.  
  
Our CS Technology organization powers customer service by developing elegant customer and Customer Service Associate (CSA)-facing products globally. These products offer effortless self-service and automation solutions to our customers. When customers prefer to interact with a human, we enable CSAs to effectively and elegantly solve customer issues using associate-facing products powered by human-centered design.  
  
Our team is looking for a talented and experienced Senior Product Manager – Technical to own a critical channel and workstream within our associate-facing product suite. In this role, you will balance current-state operational excellence with long-term platform transformation — ensuring your workstream is stable today while building toward the next generation of dynamic, personalised associate experiences. You will manage escalations and backlog prioritisation, integrate new capabilities without degrading the associate experience, and serve as a strong advocate for your work stream across cross-functional teams.  
  
A successful candidate thrives in a highly collaborative, ambiguous, and fast-paced environment, with a proven track record of end-to-end ownership, delivering results at scale, and driving meaningful improvements to both associate and customer experiences.  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Own the end-to-end associate experience for your designated channel or workstream, driving quality, reliability, and continuous improvement
* Manage escalations and backlog prioritization, ensuring the most impactful improvements are delivered efficiently

  

* Partner with engineering, design, and operations teams to deliver seamless feature integrations that enhance — rather than disrupt — the associate experience
* Advocate for your workstream in cross-functional forums, ensuring new platform capabilities account for your channel's unique requirements
* Balance short-term operational needs with long-term strategic goals, positioning your workstream for scale and future innovation

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

* Experience in representing and advocating for a variety of critical customers and stakeholders during executive-level prioritization and planning

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

**Spiceworks | Cloud Help Desk & Inventory Online**

**The Opportunity**

Spiceworks has been an industry pillar for more than 15 years, cultivating a community of millions of IT professionals. Its flagship IT Helpdesk product, now Cloud Help Desk (CHD), has evolved from a completely free, ad-supported solution to a freemium, subscription-based model designed to provide users with an ad-free experience and additional premium features.

We are looking for a hands-on Growth Marketing Manager to own user acquisition and lifecycle execution across Cloud Help Desk and Inventory Online. This is a high-drive individual contributor role for someone who enjoys building, launching, testing, and optimizing growth programs directly. You will be responsible for increasing user acquisition, reactivating lapsed users, engaging active free users, and helping convert qualified users into premium subscribers.

You will work closely with Product Management, Community, and internal product experts. * Hands-on experience with user segmentation, behavioral targeting, email journeys, conversion funnels, and campaign optimization.
* Experience organizing and executing community events, user meetups, workshops, roadshows, or other field marketing initiatives.
* Strong growth-oriented copywriting skills, with the ability to translate product capabilities and updates into clear, compelling user benefits.
* Strong analytical mindset with comfort working with user data, acquisition metrics, conversion rates, campaign performance, and growth targets.
* Ability to work independently, move quickly, experiment, learn from results, and take ownership of execution.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly when partnering with Product, Community, and technical subject-matter experts.

**Required Education and/or Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Prior experience in a SaaS, technology, IT, developer, workflow, or digital product environment is preferred.

Spiceworks is a technology-focused community and software business serving IT professionals. The role will have end-to-end ownership of NPD strategy, feasibility, process development, tooling and fixture development, CNC/VMC programming, prototype development, trials, validation, costing, customer approvals and production handover. jobs.title: Delivery Director
jobs.description:
We are Two Circles. We are a Sports & Entertainment Marketing business. We grow audiences and revenues by knowing fans best.

We work with clients to help them understand and influence fan behaviour — how fans spend their money, the events they attend, the channels they respond to, and the content they engage with. We use this understanding to help our clients grow both direct-to-consumer and business-to-business revenues.

Our platforms and services are trusted by over 1,000 clients globally, including the English Premier League, Red Bull, UEFA, VISA, the NFL, Nike and Amazon. We are over 1,000 people, based across 15 offices worldwide, delivering work for sports and entertainment organisations of all shapes and sizes.

India is a long-term commitment for Two Circles. We're already trusted by the BCCI, one of the biggest and most important properties in world sport, and our Hyderabad office sits at the heart of that relationship. Being here, and succeeding here, is central to how we build a better future for the sports and entertainment industry globally.

Hyderabad is a Two Circles office, not a GCC. Today it's tech-centric, but our ambition is to diversify what we build here over time, growing into a broad Two Circles presence rather than staying confined to technology propositions.

We're looking for a Delivery Director to lead our Hyderabad delivery organisation: a team of around 50 engineers, QA and delivery specialists, and still growing. This is a hands-on leadership role, not a governance role sitting apart from the work. You'll take direct ownership of how delivery runs day to day, build a high-performing team, and set the tone for its spirit.

You'll report to our APAC Managing Director, with a dotted line to our Engineering Directors for Data and for Digital Products & CRM, who hold technical direction for their respective practices. As the most senior Two Circles leader in Hyderabad, you'll also play an important role in our work with BCCI, our most important partner in India.

We want Hyderabad to be known, by 2029, not just for delivering the work, but for shaping it, owning it, and making it better. That means more ownership of outcomes, greater exposure to our clients and their problems, more leaders and careers built from within Hyderabad, and a reputation for ideas, innovation and smart use of AI, all while protecting the spirit and connection that makes Two Circles what it is as we grow. You'll be the person most accountable for getting us there.

Leading the Team and Its Spirit

* Lead, grow and retain the India delivery team, including recruitment, onboarding and development of new team members.
* Co-own the spirit of our Hyderabad office with our HR Lead. You'll treat this as a core part of your job, not something handed off to the HR team. You will be the role model of Two Circles spirit in the office.
* Build an India leadership layer of Engineering Managers, QA leadership and delivery leadership. Embed progression frameworks, career pathways and regular, structured feedback.
* Be a visible, accessible leader in the office. Build strong relationships and encourage the face-to-face collaboration that builds trust and improves delivery.

Delivery and Engineering Excellence

* Own the software delivery lifecycle across India projects, with consistent processes that drive quality and predictability.
* Oversee QA and release management standards across India builds, aligned with our global standards.
* Stay close to the work: attend key governance forums, review delivery health weekly, and step in when projects need support.
* Partner with our Tech Leads and Engineering Directors to ensure technical standards and architectural approaches are followed and executed well.
* Embed the agentic engineering practices being rolled out across our global teams. Drive adoption in India and share what you learn.
* Help the India team take increasing ownership of outcomes end-to-end, including design, not just execution, and reduce reliance on other regions to unblock problems.

Performance, Metrics and Governance

* Create and run a monthly governance process and health report for the India team, covering hiring, onboarding, attrition, utilisation, quality, performance and progress on major initiatives.
* Own delivery, quality and team health metrics, including code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues. Track how project leaders elsewhere in the business rate the India team's work.
* Own utilisation and cost efficiency across India delivery. Propose the India hiring plan and work with Delivery Directors globally on resource planning and hotspots.
* Keep any scorecard or metrics simple and supportive, not a tool that creates pressure. Psychological safety and performance measurement need to be built together, not treated as separate things.

Client Leadership

* Act as Client Lead for BCCI: our most senior relationship owner in India, accountable for client governance and margin efficiency. We'd expect this to take up roughly 10% of your time.
* Represent our engineering and delivery capability in client meetings in India, drawing on the work we deliver globally.

Global Collaboration

* Give leadership upward visibility, and give teams clarity on priorities, outcomes and decisions.
* Work with Directors in Melbourne, London and Vancouver to develop operating models that let teams work smoothly across regions.
* Help Hyderabad become a knowledge hub, not just a delivery team: bring in what's working well from London, Melbourne and Vancouver, and feed Hyderabad's own innovations back out to the rest of the business.
* Work effectively across time zones and cultures, bringing structure and clarity to complex, global work.

What Success Looks Like in Your First Year

* A high-performing team, shown in hard metrics such as code quality, production defects and time to resolve issues, and in strong feedback from the project leaders the team works with across regions.

How you work

● **Genuine drive:** You enjoy building software that people in the company use every day, and you keep improving it after the first version works.

About Lilly
  
  
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. Manufacturing & Quality Technical Hub, Hyderabad
  
  
Lilly's Hyderabad hub is a first-of-its-kind technical center built to lead the manufacturing and quality science agenda for Lilly's global supply network, and the work done here reaches patients in more than 110 countries.
  
This hub oversees contract manufacturing of starting materials and intermediates for API manufacturing in India, managing the full scientific agenda for manufacturing and quality. We're building a cutting-edge scientific organization and looking for top talent in process engineering, chemistry, analytical and data sciences to be part of it.
  
The science you develop here doesn't stay here. It moves through Lilly's global supply network and reaches patients across more than 110 countries who are counting on it.
  
  
Digital Manufacturing Engineering (DME) is part of the Corporate Engineering Tech Center (ETC). The ETC is a technical resource for training, standards, project implementation, and the center of engineering excellence for the corporation, providing deeply technical resources to solve the most intractable technical problems in manufacturing. DME provides Digital Engineering Platform ownership, OT data integration solutions, engineering data standardization/ownership, and digital manufacturing solutions for Lilly Manufacturing. Our team focuses on connecting our facilities (securely) and leveraging the data from those facilities to deliver digital manufacturing solutions to improve manufacturing productivity, data integrity / compliance, quality, and operational excellence. Digital Manufacturing Technologies include digital twins, computational modeling, edge/IoT, and analytics solutions. Digital Engineering Platforms include CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System), GECMS (Global Engineering Content Management System) and many other digital platforms leveraged by engineers across Lilly Manufacturing.
  
  
Position Description and Responsibilities
  
  
The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer will design, develop, support, and continuously enhance digital solutions across Lilly's global manufacturing network, while serving as the owner for one or more digital products developed by the DME team. Representative solutions in scope span the four pillars of the Engineering Digital Strategy and include — but are not limited to — the Intralogistics Monitor (ILM), Audit Trail solutions, Condition-Based Maintenance solutions, RCA and troubleshooting solutions, equipment health and predictive maintenance dashboards, capital project and qualification workflow tools, engineering knowledge search, and inspection-readiness data products. These solutions are developed on standard Digital Engineering Platforms supported by the DME team, and the engineer will partner with data leads to ensure the necessary IT, OT, and ET data is available to support each solution. This role is not focused on training or developing foundation models; it is focused on applying AI tools effectively and responsibly to manufacturing problems. This is a global role, supporting functional initiatives and all Lilly Manufacturing sites globally.
  
This role operates within an evolved Digital Solutions Engineering operating model. The team includes a Rapid Innovation branch that works at speed to prototype concepts and proof-of-value solutions against key business problems surfaced from the manufacturing network. The Principal Digital Solutions Engineer takes ownership of those solutions once they have been validated as worth scaling — maturing them from prototype to production-grade, hardening them for validated-system and data-integrity requirements, deploying and supporting them across sites, and providing long-term ownership over their roadmap, enhancement, and lifecycle. This split lets the Rapid Innovation branch stay focused on speed and discovery while the Principal Digital Solutions Engineer ensures that the most valuable concepts become durable, well-supported solutions that scale across the global manufacturing network.

jobs.title: Leading Associate Vice President - Product Owner - IT Service Management [T500-25884]
jobs.description:
**About Deutsche Börse Group:**

Headquartered in Frankfurt, Germany, Deutsche Börse Group is a leading international exchange organization and market infrastructure provider. They empower investors, financial institutions, and companies by facilitating access to global capital markets.

Their India centre is located in Hyderabad, serves as a key strategic hub and comprises India’s top-tier tech talent. They focus on crafting advanced IT solutions that elevate market infrastructure and services. Deutsche Börse Group in India is composed of a team of capital market engineers forming the backbone of financial markets worldwide.

**Field of activity:**

Corporate IT – together with the CTO Area - is driving together the Implementation of ServiceNow for IT-Service & Asset Management. This is a multi-year program professionalizing and standardizing the handling of CMDB, Asset Management, ITSM and other processes/activities. The IT SAM Program is pursuing a.o. following goals:

* Deliver a group wide IT-Service & Asset Management Platform in the cloud in line with the enterprise architecture
* Replace legacy technology (CRM7) to Cloud native technology track
* Drive cultural change form proprietary DBG specific implementation into a SaaS solution

**Your Mission:**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Product Owner to lead the topic of Integration and Reporting by means of API’s and Dashboards in our IT-Service & Asset Management (IT SAM) capabilities. You will be at the heart of our digital transformation, driving the implementation and evolution of our new central platform. This is a key role in shifting our culture from a legacy, process-heavy environment to a modern, cloud-native, and service-oriented model.

If you are a practical leader who thinks in terms of products and services that deliver real value, and you are passionate about building modern IT solutions, this is the role for you. We need a doer, not just a theorist, who can cut through complexity and guide our organization towards a more efficient and user-centric future.

**Tasks / Responsibilities:**

* **Own the Product Vision & Strategy:**
  You will define and champion a clear product vision for IT Service and Asset Management. You'll translate the strategic goals of our multi-year transformation program into a prioritized, value-driven product backlog. This includes owning, developing, maintaining, prioritizing and securing completeness of the Product Backlog with, on top of business requirements, external and internal audit items, BAU activities and Enablers.
* **Lead with a Practical Mindset:**
  While familiarity with ITIL is essential, your focus will be on practical application. You will pragmatically balance business needs with governance requirements, ensuring we build effective services, not just "paper tiger" processes.
* **Drive Agile Execution**
  : As the "Voice of the Customer," you will guide our Agile development team. This includes breaking down features into clear user stories, defining objectives, goals and acceptance criteria, and ensuring the team is always working on what matters most. You will be the final authority on accepting work, using Behaviour-Driven Development (BDD) practices and practices like Definition of Ready (DoR) and the Definition of Done (DoD), ensuring the final product meets our high standards.
* **Champion Service Adoption & Value:**
  You will own the strategy for product adoption, ensuring users understand and benefit from the new platform. A key part of your role will be evaluating new features from our SaaS vendor to ensure we are maximizing the value of our investment.
* **Collaborate and Communicate:**
  You will be the central point of contact between senior stakeholders, business users, and the development team. Your ability to communicate clearly and manage relationships at all levels will be critical to aligning everyone on the product roadmap and ensuring smooth execution.
* **Manage the Basics:**
  This includes managing JIRA / Confluence / Sharepoint together with the Product Team. Organizing, preparing and following up different types of program meetings. Contributing to program communication content and channels (mail, newsletter, intranet)

**Qualifications / Required skills:**

* **Proven Product Ownership Experience:**
  5+ years of experience as a Product Owner (or similar role) in a large-scale, enterprise Agile environment.
* **Deep Domain Expertise:**
  Strong, hands-on experience with Integration, Reporting by means of API’s and Dashboards on IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and a deep understanding of the underlying data (CMDB).
* **Practical SaaS Implementation Skills:**
  Demonstrated experience in implementing and managing enterprise SaaS solutions (ServiceNow experience is a significant advantage). You understand how to leverage out-of-the-box capabilities over excessive customization.
* **A Product & Service Mentality:**
  You are a strategic thinker who focuses on customer needs and delivering tangible business value. You have a track record of simplifying complex problems and communicating effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* **Leadership & Influence:**
  Excellent communication, negotiation, and decision-making skills. You are confident engaging with stakeholders at all levels and can operate effectively in a multi-national environment.
* **Industry Context:**
  Experience working in the financial services industry or another highly regulated environment is highly desirable.
* **Language:**
  Excellent proficiency in written and spoken English is required. Basic German is a plus.

Technical product owner
jobs.description:
Job Description: Technical Product Owner

The Technical Product Owner is responsible for translating business goals into clear, actionable technical requirements and ensuring delivery teams build solutions that maximize customer and business value. This role bridges product strategy, architecture, engineering, and operations by managing the product backlog, defining user stories and acceptance criteria, prioritizing technical and functional work, and driving execution across agile teams. Successful Technical Product Owners combine strong product judgment, technical fluency, stakeholder management, and data-driven decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

* Own and maintain the product backlog for technical and functional features, enablers, integrations, and technical debt.
* Partner with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, and designers to define product vision, roadmap, and release priorities.
* Translate business needs into epics, features, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria and technical context.
* Prioritize backlog items based on business value, customer impact, risk, dependencies, and implementation complexity.
* Work closely with engineering teams during sprint planning, refinement, demos, and retrospectives to ensure alignment and delivery readiness.
* Clarify requirements, answer team questions, and make timely tradeoff decisions to keep delivery moving.
* Align product decisions with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, reliability, and scalability requirements.
* Coordinate across teams to manage dependencies, integrations, and release readiness.
* Use customer feedback, analytics, operational metrics, and testing results to refine priorities and improve outcomes.
* Communicate progress, risks, decisions, and roadmap changes to stakeholders and leadership.
* Apply specification-driven development (SDD) practices and AI-assisted tools to generate specifications and develop prototypes that validate business asks and expected business value.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6-12 years of experience in Product Owner, Product Manager, Business Analyst, or related delivery roles in software or digital product environments.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum or SAFe environments with cross-functional delivery teams.
* Strong understanding of software development lifecycle, APIs, integrations, cloud platforms, data flows, and system dependencies.
* Proven ability to write user stories, define acceptance criteria, and manage/prioritize a product backlog.
* Experience collaborating with engineering, architecture, QA, UX, and business stakeholders.
* Strong conceptual, analytical, problem-solving, communication, and facilitation skills, including whiteboarding, written documentation, and executive-level presentations.
* Experience with delivery and product management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Familiarity with specification-driven development (SDD) and experience using AI-assisted tools such as OpenSpec, Spec-Kit, Superpowers, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent platforms to generate specifications and develop prototypes that validate business asks and expected business value.

Preferred Qualifications

* Certification such as CSPO, SAFe POPM, CSM, or equivalent agile/product credential.
* Experience in regulated enterprise environments such as healthcare, financial services, insurance, or other compliance-driven industries.
* Working knowledge of cloud services, platform architecture, data governance, DevSecOps, and observability practices.
* Experience supporting modernization initiatives, platform migrations, or digital transformation programs.
* Prior technical background in software engineering, systems analysis, solution architecture, or technical business analysis.

Core Skills

* Backlog management and prioritization
* User story development and acceptance criteria definition
* Executive communication, whiteboarding, and written documentation
* Technical requirement analysis
* Agile planning and release management
* Dependency management and risk mitigation
* Data-informed decision-making
* Customer-centric thinking
* Cross-functional leadership without direct authority
* Experience with SDD and AI-assisted spec/prototype generation tools to accelerate requirements definition and business-value validation

Success Measures

* Clear, prioritized, and delivery-ready backlog aligned to roadmap objectives
* Improved sprint predictability and release quality
* Reduced ambiguity in requirements and fewer delivery blockers
* Strong alignment between business needs and technical implementation
* Positive stakeholder and team feedback on collaboration and clarity
* Measurable business and customer outcomes from shipped features

Work Environment and Notes

Desirable

* Integration experience with SAP S/4HANA

We are looking for an experienced **Data Engineer / Analytics Engineer** with strong expertise in **Databricks Lakehouse, Spark/PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, and dimensional data modeling**. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience building enterprise-scale data platforms, ETL/ELT pipelines, curated data products, and semantic layers that support **business intelligence, analytics, AI, and machine learning use cases**.

The role requires a strong combination of **data engineering, analytics engineering, platform optimization, and data modeling**, along with the ability to work closely with business and technology stakeholders.

  

**Role & responsibilities**

  

* Design and implement modern data architectures using **Databricks Lakehouse** and **Medallion Architecture (Bronze, Silver, Gold)**.
* Build and maintain scalable **ETL/ELT pipelines** using **Spark, PySpark, SQL, Delta Lake, and Databricks Workflows**.
* Develop curated, reusable data products supporting reporting, analytics, AI, and ML use cases.
* Apply Delta Lake optimization techniques including **partitioning, Z-Ordering, data skipping, file compaction, and Change Data Feed (CDF)**.
* Implement **CI/CD, Git, DataOps, and DevOps** practices for data engineering solutions.

**Data Modeling & Analytics Engineering**

* Design and maintain scalable **dimensional data models**, including **Star and Snowflake schemas**.
* Translate complex business requirements into reliable analytical datasets and reporting solutions.
* Define and standardize **business metrics, KPIs, dimensions, hierarchies, and calculations**.
* Create reusable datasets, semantic models, and common data assets to improve consistency and reduce duplication.

**Semantic & Context Layer**

* Design and manage enterprise **semantic and context layers** to establish a consistent source of truth for analytics and reporting.
* Enable self-service analytics through platforms such as **Power BI and Tableau**, as well as AI-driven applications.
* Support metric certification, metadata management, lineage, and governance of semantic models.

**Performance & Cost Optimization**

* Analyze query execution plans and troubleshoot performance bottlenecks.
* Optimize Spark workloads using **cluster sizing, autoscaling, caching, broadcast joins, and Adaptive Query Execution (AQE)**.
* Optimize Delta Lake tables and data models for better query and reporting performance.
* Monitor platform utilization and drive performance and cloud cost efficiencies.

**Data Quality & Governance**

* Build data quality frameworks, validation controls, automated monitoring, and alerting.
* Support **data governance, data cataloging, metadata management, lineage, and data stewardship**.
* Ensure data solutions align with enterprise security, governance, regulatory, and quality standards.

**Technical Leadership & Collaboration**

* Partner with **data engineers, analytics engineers, data scientists, analysts, product owners, and business stakeholders**.
* Participate in architecture and technical design discussions and recommend engineering best practices.
* Mentor junior engineers and help drive adoption of enterprise data engineering standards and frameworks.
* Contribute to data platform strategy, architecture, and roadmap discussions.
* Comply with applicable company policies, procedures, business directives, and working arrangements.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)

* Maintain version control for all custom applications and ensure all code is archived, documented in GitHub, and tracked through Jira and Confluence.
* Manage SQL Server stored procedures and optimize SQL views and queries, troubleshooting and resolving job or runtime errors as they arise.
* Take ownership of existing workflows and support them using the tools already in place, learning rapidly and acting decisively to keep systems stable.
* Operate effectively under pressure, solving complex problems in mission-critical environments while maintaining clear documentation and communication throughout.

**AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY**

We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING**

Required Qualifications:

* Five or more years of software development experience using agile methodology, with at least five years supporting legacy ERP and fulfillment software.
* Hands-on experience with ERP domains including Order Management, Inventory Control, and Fulfillment — preferably within Microsoft Dynamics SL or comparable platforms.
* Proficiency with SQL Server stored procedures, query optimization, and troubleshooting SQL job or runtime errors.
* Experience writing production software in one or more of the following languages: C#, Java, Go, or Python, with access to relational databases.
* Familiarity with GitHub or GitLab, containerization, and CI/CD pipelines; experience with event streaming platforms such as Kafka, Pulsar, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, or SQS is strongly preferred.
* Understanding of APIs, integration patterns, and batch-driven workflows, with demonstrated ability to build wrapper services connecting legacy and modern systems.

Education:

Bachelor’s in computer science, Computer Engineering, or a related field required.

Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in Hyderabad, India, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence 3 days per week i.e., Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday.

* Virtualisation technologies and hypervisors.

* Ability to balance customer requests, engineering constraints, technical improvements, and business priorities.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Experience defining product success metrics and evaluating outcomes.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will:

* Have worked as a Product Manager, Technical Product Manager, Platform Product Manager, or in a comparable product ownership role.
* Have hands-on exposure to infrastructure-related products or technically complex platforms.
* Demonstrate a clear understanding of platform users, their challenges, and the value delivered by the product.

**kAIgentic** is building the intelligence layer for the world's most ambitious enterprises. Headquartered in Singapore with teams in India and Japan, our software platform helps large organizations evolve as fast as technology itself by turning the tacit know-how locked inside their people into safe, governed, AI-powered operations.

The hardest part of enterprise transformation is not strategy. It is execution. Institutional knowledge lives in people's heads, systems are fragmented, and risk tolerance is low. kAIgentic captures how work actually happens, designs better workflows, and runs them inside an intelligence layer that is observable, auditable, and engineered for the most regulated environments on earth. The outcome is an enterprise that continuously improves.

We are backed by SMBC Group as our founding partner and customer zero, and our platform is already being proven inside one of the most complex, regulated operating environments in the world. That means real problems, real data, and real production impact from Day 1.

You will own one significant part of our product estate end to end: strategy, requirements, delivery and adoption. You will also be kAIgentic’s experience lead across the platform. You will set the principles and patterns every product follows, and own the journeys that cross product boundaries.

Our users do hard, regulated work: confirming how a bank process really runs, redesigning it, and deciding what to automate. The job is not to make that work look simple. It is to remove the labour that shouldn’t be there, keep the expert judgment that should, and make human review mean something.

**What You’ll Do**

* Set the experience principles and interaction patterns all products follow. These cover how the product shows confidence and uncertainty, when it asks a person for input, and how review and approval work. Hold the bar in design reviews.
* Own the journeys that cross products, so that what a user confirms in one carries cleanly into the next.
* Design human review that auditors and regulators would accept as meaningful, not a rubber stamp, and define how we measure that it is.

* Mastery of product discovery and delivery frameworks, including hypothesis-driven research, PRD authoring, and iterative validation.

* Exceptional judgment in balancing technical feasibility, security, and scalability with user value.

**Company Description**
-----------------------

Technology is our how. And people are our why. For over two decades, we have been harnessing technology to drive meaningful change.

From prototype to real-world impact - be part of a global shift by doing work that matters.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**

Scrum Masters enable the implementation of scrum framework and its principles, values, and practices within a squad. The role acts as a servant leader who helps their teams to deliver value incrementally in a collaborative manner. They are aligned to one or two squads.

**Core Duties/Responsibilities**

The successful candidate will be responsible for the following:

* Acts as a servant leader by serving the needs of the Scrum Team, removing obstacles, and empowering team members to take ownership of their work.
* Promotes continuous improvement by facilitating Sprint Retrospectives, identifying opportunities, and implementing action plans.
* Encourages reflection on processes and supports incremental changes.
* Continuously develops personal knowledge and skills by engaging with Scrum communities, attending training, obtaining certifications, and seeking feedback.
* Coaches the Scrum Team on Scrum practices, principles, and values, fostering self-organization and continuous improvement.
* Facilitates collaboration and communication within the team and with stakeholders, promoting transparency and a culture of openness and trust.
* Encourages cross-functional collaboration between Development Teams and other groups.
* Supports the Product Owner in managing the Product Backlog, refining User Stories, and prioritizing work to maximize value.
* Supports up to one Squad by facilitating group activities or workshops in complex and ambiguous situations with competing stakeholder needs.
* Designs structured sequences of meetings, events, or workshops to solve complex problems.
* Understands required outcomes and guides the team to deliver them.
* Facilitates all Scrum events—Sprint Planning, Daily Scrum, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives—ensuring they are effective, focused, and time-boxed.
* Removes impediments by identifying blockers, collaborating with stakeholders, and resolving issues proactively. Protects the team from external distractions during the Sprint.
* Helps improve team processes and performance in meetings, events, or workshops.
* Ensures Scrum artifacts such as the Product Backlog, Sprint Backlog, and Burndown Charts are transparent and up-to-date by working closely with the Product Owner and Development Team.
* Provides key metrics to senior stakeholders to maintain visibility into progress and priorities.

The duties and responsibilities outlined above are to be regarded as broad areas of responsibility and do not necessarily detail all tasks which the post holder may be required to perform.

**Qualifications**
------------------

**Skills, Capabilities and Attributes**

The ideal candidate will have the below skills, capabilities and attributes essential or preferred.

* Azure DevOps
* Jira
* Agile Methodologies - Scrum/Kanban
* Awareness of Scaling
* Leading, educating, and coaching
* Efficiency improvement
* Documentation
* Lifecycle management
* Problem solving

**Measures of success**

* Improves team flow and delivery predictability through effective Scrum facilitation and coaching practices.
* Drives continuous improvement through retrospectives, actionable insights and measurable team outcomes.
* Removes impediments quickly while protecting team focus and enabling consistent Sprint delivery.
* Strengthens collaboration, transparency and trust across teams and stakeholders consistently.
* Ensures Scrum artefacts are accurate, visible and support informed decision-making effectively.
* Supports Product Owner to refine backlog, improving clarity, prioritisation and delivery value.

jobs.title: Head of special Projects
jobs.description:
**Head of Special Projects**
============================

**Role Overview**
-----------------

The Head of Special Projects will work closely with the MD & CEO to shape business strategy, identify growth opportunities and lead selected strategic initiatives from concept to implementation. The role connects customer needs, distribution dynamics, product choices, business economics and organisational capabilities to develop practical recommendations for building and scaling the business.

This is a broad business strategy and execution role with an enterprise-wide perspective. The individual should be comfortable working with financial numbers and understanding how channels operate on the ground, which products can succeed through them, what capabilities are required, and what makes a proposition viable for customers, partners and the company.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **1. Business Strategy and Opportunity Development**

* Work with the CEO and leadership team to shape medium- and long-term strategy, including customer segments, growth priorities and choices on where to compete.
* Identify and evaluate new business opportunities through market research, customer and partner interactions, field insights and competitive analysis.
* Integrate distribution, product, operational and financial considerations; articulate assumptions, trade-offs and risks.
* Translate broad ideas into clear proposals covering the opportunity, strategic fit, business model, required capabilities and recommended next steps.

### **2. Distribution Channels and Partnerships**

* Evaluate potential channels and partnerships, including opportunities through the promoter groups network and relevant financial services and distribution ecosystems.
* Understand channel dynamics such as customer access and trust, seller behaviour, partner incentives, sales processes, productivity, training, servicing and collections.
* Develop viable distribution models that integrate the customer and partner propositions, product fit, commercial arrangements and operating requirements.
* Assess channel economics with Finance, including achievable volumes, acquisition and servicing costs, partner remuneration, productivity, profitability and capital implications.
* Work with business owners to design pilots, support partnership discussions and recommend whether to launch, refine or scale opportunities.

### **3. Customer Propositions and Product Strategy**

* Identify customer protection and savings needs, particularly among underserved and unserved segments, and translate them into commercially viable propositions.
* Assess product-channel fit, considering affordability, simplicity, customer behaviour, sales capability, servicing and long-term customer outcomes.
* Work with Product, Distribution and Operations to evaluate product options and build an integrated product and channel roadmap.
* Evaluate product opportunities based on customer value, competitive positioning, expected demand, persistency, claims experience, profitability and capital requirements.
* Coordinate selected proposition pilots and launches with functional owners; use results to recommend changes and scaling decisions.

### **4. Operating Model, Organisation and Capabilities**

* Determine execution requirements for proposed business models, including people, roles, skills, processes, technology, service capacity and governance.
* Assess staffing and deployment models for new initiatives, including central teams, field support and partner-facing resources.
* Work with functional leaders to evaluate build, buy, partner or outsource options and define practical implementation approaches.
* Identify cross-functional dependencies and execution bottlenecks; develop solutions that balance growth, cost, customer experience and control.

### **5. Strategic Projects and Execution**

* Lead selected CEO-sponsored cross-functional projects, such as new distribution models, retail business development, partnerships, operating model changes and business improvement initiatives.
* Bring relevant teams together, resolve interdependencies and drive agreed actions through to completion.
* Use pilots and structured experimentation to test critical assumptions before committing significant resources.

### **6. CEO Decision Support and Strategic Alignment**

* Act as a thought partner to the CEO on complex business questions, developing clear options and evidence-based recommendations supported by commercial judgement.
* Interpret financial and business information to explain performance drivers and implications for strategic decisions.
* Work with Finance and other functions on scenarios covering growth, product and channel mix, costs, profitability and capital needs.
* Prepare strategy papers and decision materials for leadership, Board and shareholder discussions, and support alignment on strategic priorities.
* Support focused reviews of CEO-sponsored initiatives, highlighting material issues, decisions required and corrective actions.

**Qualifications & Experience**
-------------------------------

### **Education**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate/professional qualification in business, strategy, finance, economics, actuarial science or a related discipline. Relevant experience and demonstrated capability will also be considered.

### **Experience**

* Typically 812 years of relevant experience in corporate strategy, business development, strategy consulting, a CEOs office, business management or cross-functional transformation.
* Experience in insurance or financial services, with a practical understanding of customers, distribution models and business economics.
* Demonstrated ability to assess opportunities across customer proposition, channel, product, operating model, resources and financial viability.
* Experience taking strategic initiatives beyond analysis into pilots, launch or implementation.
* Strong analytical skills and financial fluency…

Design at Maersk goes beyond interfaces and interaction patterns. We are increasingly creating connected, AI-enabled experiences that span complex end-to-end journeys. jobs.title: Business Risk Data Analyst
jobs.description:
Closing date for applications: 19/10/2026

Location Bangalore, India

Job typePermanent | Contract typeFull Time

#R-00286393

  

**Join our digital revolution in NatWest Digital X**
----------------------------------------------------

In everything we do, we work to one aim. To make digital experiences which are effortless and secure.

So we organise ourselves around three principles: engineer, protect, and operate. We engineer simple solutions, we protect our customers, and we operate smarter.

**Job description**
-------------------

This role is based in India and as such all normal working days must be carried out in India.

Join us as a Business Risk Data Analyst

  
  

* Join a forward-thinking Data, Automation and AI team that is shaping the future of risk insight across Commercial & Institutional Banking
* We’ll look to you to provide high-quality analytical expertise that supports innovative automation, data and AI-driven solutions driving across Business Risk
* This is a hands-on opportunity to deepen your technical and analytical skills while working on initiatives that deliver meaningful business impact
* We're offering this role at associate level
  

  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  

As a Business Risk Data Analyst, you'll play an important role in delivering data-driven solutions that support risk management and decision-making. You’ll work across the data lifecycle, from extraction, processing and analysis through to visualisation and automation, helping make sure data is accurate, reliable and fit for purpose.

  
  

Day-to-day, you’ll also be:

  
  

* Collecting, profiling and mapping data to support reporting, automation initiatives and AI-enabled solutions
* Analysing and documenting risk process and data flows, helping establish consistent data definitions, standards and models
* Translating business risk requirements into functional and data solutions, supporting the development of automated processes and self-service analytics capabilities
* Building and maintaining collaborative partnerships with key stakeholders across Business Risk, Corporate Services and the Growth Office to support the successful delivery of data-led initiatives
  

  

**The skills you'll need**
--------------------------

  
  

Our bank is dedicated to using data, automation and AI responsibly to improve risk management and business outcomes. We’re looking for someone with experience using data analysis and visualisation tools to deliver meaningful insight within a Risk or Technology environment. Knowledge of Amazon QuickSight or Microsoft PowerPlatform solutions would be advantageous. You’ll combine strong analytical thinking with curiosity for exploring data and solving problems through insight and innovation.

  
  

We’ll also look for:

  
  

* An in-depth understanding of the interrelationships of data structures, relationships and multiple data domains, with experience working within cloud-based data environments such as AWS
* Experience delivering analysis and insight using both qualitative and quantitative data across a range of business and risk-related subjects
* Strong communication and influencing skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and requirements for both technical and non-technical stakeholders

**Welcome to our Bangalore hub**
--------------------------------

Located at Taurus 4, Bagmane Constellation Business Park, our new office stands as a state-of-the-art hub for innovation and collaboration.

### **Key facts:**

* A 30 acre campus
* Space for 6,000 colleagues
* Opened in 2025
